answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Scoring. Each identity accrues a behavioral fingerprint per epoch; the score compares drift across epochs, and identities whose inter-epoch distance exceeds a threshold lose harbor privileges for the next cycle. Roots of trust are anchored at a jetty checkpoint, where a sampled audit replays recent actions. To survive, an attacker must sustain coherent behavior across many epochs, and each sybil must fund its own consistent grove of activity histories, multiplying per-identity operating cost linearly.
